cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `NVCodecs`（模块 `NVCodecs`、`NVCodecsRHI`、`NVDEC`、`NVENC`）。
它把 NVIDIA Media Codec SDK 的编解码器（NVDEC 解码/NVENC 编码）加入 AVCodecs。
在录制/解码流程里选 NVENC/NVDEC，享受 GPU 硬件加速。
Experimental：接口可能变动；需 NVIDIA GPU 与相应驱动。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `NVCodecs` (modules `NVCodecs`, `NVCodecsRHI`, `NVDEC`, `NVENC`).
It adds NVIDIA Media Codec SDK codecs (NVDEC decode / NVENC encode) to AVCodecs.
Choose NVENC/NVDEC in recording/decoding flows for GPU hardware acceleration.
Experimental: contract may change; requires an NVIDIA GPU and drivers.
note_cn: 把 NVIDIA NVENC/NVDEC 编解码加入 AVCodecs，实验性。
note_en: Adds NVIDIA NVENC/NVDEC codecs to AVCodecs, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 `NVDEC hardware decoder support for Electra`（模块 `NVDECElectra`）。
它为 Electra 播放器加入来自 NVIDIA Media Codec SDK 的硬件解码（NVDEC）。
在 Media Player 选 Electra 后端播放视频，由 NVDEC 硬解；支持的编解码取决于 GPU。
需 D3D12 与 NVIDIA GPU；属 Media Framework 解码扩展。
en_steps: Enable `NVDEC hardware decoder support for Electra` (module `NVDECElectra`).
It adds hardware decoding (NVDEC) from the NVIDIA Media Codec SDK to the Electra player.
Play video via a Media Player with the Electra backend, hardware-decoded by NVDEC; supported codecs depend on the GPU.
Requires D3D12 and an NVIDIA GPU; it is a Media Framework decode extension.
note_cn: Electra 的 NVDEC 硬件解码（需 D3D12/NVIDIA GPU）。
note_en: NVDEC hardware decoding for Electra (needs D3D12/NVIDIA GPU).

cn_steps: 启用 `NVidia GeForce NOW Wrapper`（模块 `GeForceNOWWrapper`），运行时插件。
它把 GeForce NOW 云游戏相关能力封装进引擎（平台/流式集成）。
在 GeForce NOW 目标平台下打包/运行，调用其接口。
运行时模块可进游戏包；仅在 GeForce NOW 环境下有意义。
en_steps: Enable `NVidia GeForce NOW Wrapper` (module `GeForceNOWWrapper`), a runtime plugin.
It wraps GeForce NOW cloud-gaming capabilities into the engine (platform/streaming integration).
Package/run on the GeForce NOW target platform and call its API.
Runtime modules can ship; meaningful only in the GeForce NOW environment.
note_cn: GeForce NOW 云游戏的引擎封装（运行时）。
note_en: An engine wrapper for GeForce NOW cloud gaming (runtime).

cn_steps: 启用 `NVIDIA Rivermax Media Streaming`（运行时 `RivermaxMedia`，编辑器 `RivermaxMediaEditor`，工厂 `RivermaxMediaFactory`），属 Virtual Production。
它为媒体捕获与媒体播放器添加 NVIDIA Rivermax 功能（低延迟 SMPTE ST 2110 网络视频）。
在 Media IO/Media Player 里选 Rivermax 源/输出，接入专业网络视频流。
Game 模块依赖 `RivermaxMedia`；编辑器/工厂模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `NVIDIA Rivermax Media Streaming` (runtime `RivermaxMedia`, editor `RivermaxMediaEditor`, factory `RivermaxMediaFactory`), part of Virtual Production.
It adds NVIDIA Rivermax to media capture and media players (low-latency SMPTE ST 2110 networked video).
Select a Rivermax source/output in Media IO/Media Player to tap professional networked video.
Game modules depend on `RivermaxMedia`; editor/factory modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: NVIDIA Rivermax 的专业网络视频（ST 2110）媒体 IO。
note_en: NVIDIA Rivermax professional networked-video (ST 2110) media IO.

cn_steps: 启用 `NVIDIA Rivermax Media synchronization for nDisplay`（模块 `RivermaxSync`，编辑器 `RivermaxSyncEditor`），属 Virtual Production。
它为 nDisplay 添加 NVIDIA Rivermax 同步功能（集群间媒体/时间同步）。
在多节点 nDisplay 虚拟制片里用 Rivermax 做媒体同步。
属 nDisplay 同步扩展；需 Rivermax 与 nDisplay。
en_steps: Enable `NVIDIA Rivermax Media synchronization for nDisplay` (module `RivermaxSync`, editor `RivermaxSyncEditor`), part of Virtual Production.
It adds NVIDIA Rivermax synchronization to nDisplay (media/time sync across the cluster).
In multi-node nDisplay virtual production, use Rivermax for media synchronization.
It is an nDisplay sync extension; requires Rivermax and nDisplay.
note_cn: 为 nDisplay 增加 NVIDIA Rivermax 同步。
note_en: Adds NVIDIA Rivermax synchronization to nDisplay.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Object Mixer`（模块 `ObjectMixerEditor`）并重启。
用它的电子表格视图批量编辑场景对象的任意属性。
适合对大量 Actor/对象做对比与批量改参。
这是编辑器/开发者插件，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Object Mixer` (module `ObjectMixerEditor`) and restart.
Use its spreadsheet view to batch-edit any property of scene objects.
Great for comparing and bulk-editing properties across many actors/objects.
It is an editor/developer plugin for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 用电子表格批量编辑场景对象属性的编辑器工具。
note_en: An editor tool for spreadsheet batch-editing scene object properties.

cn_steps: 启用 `Object Tracking Insights`（模块 `ObjectTracking`、`ObjectTrackingInsights`）。
它在 Spatial Insights 视图上记录并可视化对象的位置与移动历史。
启动相关 trace 后，在 Spatial Insights 里回溯对象运动轨迹。
属 Insights/Trace 分析工具。
en_steps: Enable `Object Tracking Insights` (modules `ObjectTracking`, `ObjectTrackingInsights`).
It records and visualizes object position and movement history on the Spatial Insights view.
After starting the relevant trace, replay object trajectories in Spatial Insights.
It is an Insights/Trace analysis tool.
note_cn: 在 Spatial Insights 上记录/可视化对象运动轨迹。
note_en: Records/visualizes object movement history on Spatial Insights.

cn_steps: 启用 `Oculus Touch Controller Keys`（模块 `OculusTouchControllerKeys`）。
它定义 Oculus Touch 控制器的输入键（`OculusTouch_*` FKey），只依赖 InputCore。
无需 OpenXR 映射即可引用这些键（如 Pixel Streaming 等场景）。
轻量按键定义插件；供需要这些键的模块引用。
en_steps: Enable `Oculus Touch Controller Keys` (module `OculusTouchControllerKeys`).
It defines the Oculus Touch controller input keys (`OculusTouch_*` FKeys), depending only on InputCore.
These keys can be referenced without OpenXR mapping (e.g. Pixel Streaming scenarios).
A lightweight key-definition plugin; referenced by modules that need these keys.
note_cn: Oculus Touch 输入键的定义（仅依赖 InputCore，无需 OpenXR 映射）。
note_en: Oculus Touch input-key definitions (InputCore-only, no OpenXR mapping needed).

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `OneSky`（模块 `OneSkyLocalizationService`）并重启。
它提供 OneSky 本地化服务集成，在编辑器里上传/下载本地化文本。
在本地化设置里配置 OneSky 项目与 API 凭据，同步翻译。
这是编辑器/开发者插件，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `OneSky` (module `OneSkyLocalizationService`) and restart.
It provides OneSky localization service integration to upload/download localized text in the editor.
Configure the OneSky project and API credentials in localization settings to sync translations.
It is an editor/developer plugin for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: OneSky 本地化服务集成（编辑器同步翻译）。
note_en: OneSky localization service integration (editor translation sync).

cn_steps: 启用 `Online Base`（模块 `OnlineBase`）。
它提供在线子系统（OSSv1）与在线服务（OSSv2）接口的共享代码。
通常作为底层依赖随在线子系统/服务插件启用，不直接面向用户。
编写跨在线平台通用逻辑时才直接依赖它。
en_steps: Enable `Online Base` (module `OnlineBase`).
It provides shared code for the Online Subsystem (OSSv1) and Online Services (OSSv2) interfaces.
Usually enabled as a low-level dependency with online subsystem/service plugins, not directly user-facing.
Depend on it directly only when writing cross-platform online code.
note_cn: 在线子系统(OSSv1)/在线服务(OSSv2) 的共享底层代码。
note_en: Shared base code for Online Subsystem (OSSv1)/Online Services (OSSv2).

cn_steps: 启用 `Online Framework Common`（模块 `OnlineFrameworkCommon`）。
它提供在线框架的通用功能（共享工具/接口）。
通常随在线框架插件（如 Lobby/Party）作为底层依赖启用。
编写在线框架相关通用逻辑时才直接依赖。
en_steps: Enable `Online Framework Common` (module `OnlineFrameworkCommon`).
It provides common functionality (shared utilities/interfaces) for the online framework.
Usually enabled as a low-level dependency with online framework plugins (e.g. Lobby/Party).
Depend on it directly only when writing common online-framework logic.
note_cn: 在线框架的通用功能/工具。
note_en: Common functionality/utilities for the online framework.

cn_steps: 启用 `Online Framework Plugin`（模块 `Qos`、`Party`、`Lobby`、`PatchCheck`、`Hotfix`、`Rejoin`、`PlayTimeLimit`、`LoginFlow`）。
它提供与在线游戏服务交互的共享代码（大厅、队伍、QoS、补丁检查、热更、重连、登录流程等）。
用其模块搭建大厅/组队/登录等在线功能，接入所选 OSS。
Game 模块可进包；按需启用具体子模块。
en_steps: Enable `Online Framework Plugin` (modules `Qos`, `Party`, `Lobby`, `PatchCheck`, `Hotfix`, `Rejoin`, `PlayTimeLimit`, `LoginFlow`).
It provides shared code to interact with online game services (lobby, party, QoS, patch check, hotfix, rejoin, login flow, etc.).
Build lobby/party/login features from its modules on your chosen OSS.
Game modules can ship; enable the specific submodules you need.
note_cn: 在线游戏服务交互的共享代码（大厅/队伍/QoS/登录流程等）。
note_en: Shared code to interact with online game services (lobby/party/QoS/login flow, etc.).

cn_steps: 启用 `Online Services EOS (Game Services)`（模块 `OnlineServicesEOSGS`）。
它是仅针对 EOS 游戏服务（Epic Online Services Game Services）的在线服务实现。
在在线服务设置里选 EOS GS 提供方，配置 EOS 项目凭据。
属在线服务(OSSv2) EOS 实现；与账户服务分开。
en_steps: Enable `Online Services EOS (Game Services)` (module `OnlineServicesEOSGS`).
It is an Online Services implementation only for EOS Game Services (Epic Online Services Game Services).
Select the EOS GS provider in Online Services settings and configure EOS project credentials.
It is the Online Services (OSSv2) EOS implementation; separate from account services.
note_cn: 仅 EOS 游戏服务的在线服务实现（OSSv2）。
note_en: An Online Services (OSSv2) implementation only for EOS Game Services.

cn_steps: 启用 `Online Services EOS`（模块 `OnlineServicesEOS`）。
它是 EOS 账户与游戏服务的在线服务实现（OSSv2）。
在在线服务设置里选 EOS 提供方，配置账户/游戏服务凭据。
属在线服务/平台服务；覆盖登录、会话、成就等。
en_steps: Enable `Online Services EOS` (module `OnlineServicesEOS`).
It is the Online Services (OSSv2) implementation for EOS account and game services.
Select the EOS provider in Online Services settings and configure account/game-service credentials.
It is online/platform services; covers login, sessions, achievements, etc.
note_cn: EOS 账户与游戏服务的在线服务实现（OSSv2）。
note_en: The Online Services (OSSv2) implementation for EOS account and game services.

cn_steps: 启用 `Online Services Epic Common`（模块 `OnlineServicesEpicCommon`）。
它提供 Epic 账户服务与 Epic 游戏服务之间共享的通用在线服务实现。
作为 EOS 相关实现的共享底层，随 EOS 在线服务插件启用。
编写 Epic 在线服务通用逻辑时才直接依赖。
en_steps: Enable `Online Services Epic Common` (module `OnlineServicesEpicCommon`).
It provides common online-services implementation shared between Epic account services and Epic game services.
A shared base for EOS-related implementations; enabled with EOS online-service plugins.
Depend on it directly only when writing common Epic online-service logic.
note_cn: Epic 账户/游戏服务之间的共享在线服务实现。
note_en: Common online-services implementation shared across Epic account/game services.
